text:
Rohan: quick heads-up — noticed sidebar preview showing items from other orgs when switching workspaces. repro'd twice in prod :grimacing:
Kate: steps? can you repro on canary or only prod?
Rohan: reproduces on prod stable. Steps: open org-A, go to Runs list, hover preview on run created in org-B -> preview shows org-B title + snippet. didn't need reload.
Michelle: that sounds like the prefetch/prefetch-cache not keying by org? did we recently change cache keys for previews?
Aj: pushed a routing tweak yesterday around header passthrough for internal API calls (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1234). it removed some headers to simplify auth routing — could be related.
Rohan: saw this in the console logs:
```
GET /internal/preview?id=run-xyz
Host: console-internal
Cookie: session=abcd
X-Request-ID: req-1
# response
200 {
  "id": "run-xyz",
  "org_id": "org-B",
  "title": "Quarterly metrics"
}
```
But the cache key recorded in redis was `preview:global:run-xyz` (no org).
Michelle: yup that's the smoking gun — cache key missing org scope. looks like prefetch service computes key from path only.
Deploy-Bot: deploy completed: console-prefetch v2.7.1 (commit d9f3a2) by @Aj at 3532100200. Canary at 10%.
Elaine: can we pause the canary? if 10% hits could leak previews.
SRE-Bot: canary paused by automation due to error spike in region eu-west-1 (auto).
Aj: ack. rolling revert patch now. quick mitigation: invalidate preview cache and add org to key. pushing hotfix branch.
Priyanka: temp mitigation request: add org header to responses and console-side defensive check — don't render preview if response.org_id != currentOrg. safer short-term.
Kate: good idea. Priyanka, can you open a tiny UX-safe PR that opts out rendering and logs an event if mismatch?
Priyanka: on it. will include telemetry event: `console.preview.org_mismatch` with run id + current org (no PII).
Rohan: created a minimal repro script and attached logs in the ticket: https://issues.redwood/CON-4567 — putting steps and sample redis keys.
Michelle: next steps: (1) revert prefetch change in prod ASAP (Aj), (2) flush preview cache (SRE), (3) push console defensive check + telemetry (Priyanka), (4) postmortem/tracking (Kate).
Aj: working on revert now, will update PR link when done.
Elaine: if revert takes >10m we should consider emergency rollback of 2.7.1 via infra pipeline. I can coordinate.
SRE-Bot: cache flush scheduled: redis/console-preview namespace flush at 3532101250 (in progress).
Rohan: confirming flush removed the mismatched keys from redis, watching consoles for any further cross-org previews.
Kate: thanks everyone. after this we should add unit tests ensuring cache key includes `org_id` and add an integration test that simulates workspace switch + hover preview.
Michelle: agree. file postmortem once stabilized. :thumbsup:
